actual.descripcion: A high-speed pursuit of an April fool driving a Vauxhall Meriva. Meanwhile, another driver has managed to outrun the interceptors, but not outwit them. In Radford, the knife-crime team are faced with the growing threat of mamba.

siguiente.descripcion: The Interceptors hunt for thieves who stole ten grand's worth of luxury jackets. Police get more than they bargained for when they check out a suspicious car. And a smiling driver gives a masterclass in how not to react to being stopped by the cops.

Coups the dog handler takes Rambo in search of a gang who've been slashing lorry curtains to steal the goods inside, then joins cops from Derbyshire and Leicestershire to track a van filled with suspected stolen goods.
Phil Broughton pulls over a young lad in an old Vauxhall that's suspected of being on cloned plates. The biggest surprise of all comes when Phil discovers it's the driver's 15th birthday.
The winter is off to a hellish start when a blizzard slams the Coquihalla Highway. The team needs to be at their best when clearing a crashed truck off the road and the team makes a tragic discovery.
Jamie flies to Chattanooga, Tennessee to pick up a truck with a rotating boom that he's impatiently waiting for. The crew deals with two tough-to-flip turnovers loaded with lumber and wine.

Jamie's having second thoughts about bringing his son Brandon onboard when the teenager spends his pay cheque on ear piercings. Then his right-hand man Kevin shows up to a wreck without the gear he needs to control traffic.
